title: The Hollow Veil
author: August Hartwell
blurb: Elodie Sandoval, a debt-bound temple scribe, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
